statement: NVIDIA announced AI compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital.
why: Third-party capital is what lets buyers who cannot self-fund keep ordering accelerators, so mobilizing it loosens the financing constraint on marginal demand.

impact.mechanism: Large third-party financing platforms supply the capital that marginal buyers need to fund AI compute purchases, easing credit conditions on accelerator demand.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-10 AI compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital.

confidence.basis: Mentioned as an adjacent newsroom item summarized within this document rather than detailed in the filed release itself.
